fact: BNA Aviso 02/2022, published 2 February 2022, requires payment service providers to run a 24/7 complaints centre that follows the Aviso on consumer protection of financial products and services, with breaches punishable under the payments and financial institutions laws.
title: Aviso n.º 02/2022 - Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola - Prestação de Serviços de Pagamento
